name: gemini-adc-router
description: Keyless (ADC-only) Vertex AI Gemini 3.8 & Gemini 4.0 router and plugin for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code

interface.shortDescription: Route Codex & Claude Code to Vertex AI Gemini 3.8 / 4.0 via ADC
interface.longDescription: Keyless (Application Default Credentials only, zero API keys) local router and plugin that translates OpenAI Codex Responses API (/v1/responses) and Anthropic Messages API (/v1/messages) to Google Cloud Vertex AI Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 4.0 Argon.
defaultPrompt: Check the Gemini ADC router health and active model
Switch the Gemini ADC router primary model to gemini-4-argon
Show the Omarchy Gemini Router plugin status
